reviews.x: READ THIS CAREFULLY BEFORE PURCHASING:  KERATIN TREATMENTS REDUCE YOUR FRIZZ. That is all that they do. Get it? Yes, for some people it MIGHT relax a little bit of your curl. claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the shampoo and conditioner for leaving hair soft, shiny, and moisturized.
Many reviewers say the products tame frizz and make hair more manageable, including for curly or wavy hair.
Several reviewers note the products do not weigh hair down or make it greasy.
Some reviewers mention the products help extend or maintain keratin treatments and color.
A few reviewers describe the products as pricier than usual but worth it.

qa.q: Is this sulfate-free and safe for color-treated hair?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate the shampoo is sulfate-free [1], and several reviewers say it keeps color vibrant and lasting longer [3][4]. However, no review explicitly states it is safe for color-treated hair, so that part is only indirectly supported.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Will this work for my dry, damaged hair?
qa.answer: Reviews suggest these products help with dry, damaged hair: one reviewer with drier, more brittle hair noticed a huge change within two weeks [1], and another said the serum tamed dry over-processed frizzy hair [4]. A reviewer also advised leaving a little conditioner in if your hair tends to be dry [3].
